parts:
Dear all,

We are pleased to announce the online course GLLVMs: Advanced Multivariate Analysis of Ecological Communities in R, scheduled for 20-23 May. This course introduces Generalized Linear Latent Variable Models (GLLVMs) as a flexible, model-based alternative to traditional ordination and species distribution modeling methods.

 

Participants will learn how to:

  • Fit and interpret GLLVMs using the gllvm R package.

  • Choose appropriate model formulations for different ecological questions.

  • Diagnose model fit using residual analysis and other criteria.

  • Visualize and communicate results effectively.

  • Understand the advantages of GLLVMs over classical ordination methods.

The course is designed for PhD candidates, postdoctoral researchers, and professionals with basic knowledge of generalized linear models (GLMs) and R programming. Familiarity with generalized linear mixed models (GLMMs) or ordination methods is beneficial but not required.

 

For full details and registration, visit: https://www.physalia-courses.org/courses-workshops/gllvm/

Best regards,
